{"assessments":[{"index":0,"entryId":"CD010753","conditionMatch":true,"treatmentMatch":true,"grade":4,"topicGrade":4,"quote":"Nocturnal melatonin secretion and polysomnographic sleep patterns were investigated in ten patients with chronic primary insomnia ... after either a single intravenous administration of 25 mg doxepin or placebo ... doxepin also significantly improved sleep latency, total sleep time, and sleep efficiency in the insomniacs ... Trazodone is efficacious for sleep maintenance difficulties."},{"index":7,"entryId":"CD010753","conditionMatch":true,"treatmentMatch":true,"grade":4,"topicGrade":4,"quote":"We evaluated the capacity of trazodone ... to increase the sleep efficiency in alcohol-dependent patients after detoxification ...
